references.text: The same principle that the priest who performs the sin offering shall eat it, and that it is most holy.
Detailed instructions about the sin offering which shares the same law as the guilt offering.
The laws concerning the guilt offering, which are here said to share the same regulation as the sin offering.
The guilt offering shall be slaughtered in the same place as the sin offering, and it belongs to the priest.
The priests' portion of the most holy offerings, including the sin offering and the guilt offering.
Ezekiel's prophecy confirms that the grain offering, the sin offering, and the guilt offering belong to the priests.
Paul refers to the principle that those who serve at the altar share in the sacrifice.
Christ as High Priest making atonement, parallel to the priest making atonement in Leviticus.
